instruction: Find the arXiv paper titled 'Mistral 7B' published on October 11, 2023, and add it as a new entry in the spreadsheet with its PDF link and publication date.

parameters.window_name: New Large Language Models.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding and adding the Mistral 7B paper to the spreadsheet. The evaluator checks if a new row contains the paper title, arXiv link, and publication date with fuzzy matching (85% threshold) to account for minor formatting variations. The paper should be added in row 3 (after the existing QWEN paper in row 2).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the specified row (row 3) data with all three required fields: title, link, and date
Metric correctly compares all three fields (title, link, date) using appropriate fuzzy matching with 85% threshold
Expected values are semantically correct and match the instruction requirements (Mistral 7B paper from arXiv)
Complete coverage: All instruction requirements are verified (paper title, PDF link, publication date)
Postconfig properly saves the file before verification to ensure data persistence
Scoring weights are reasonable (0.4 for title, 0.4 for link, 0.2 for date) to prioritize critical fields
Getter handles edge cases properly (missing file, empty data) by returning empty dict
